plan.title: Negative price blocks draft line-item save

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen to build the saved draft.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition configuration.
Apply the required stage configuration before creating the draft.
A title is required to save and later reopen the draft.
Use an RFQ pricing stage so the draft has a price column.
Apply a pricing template before adding the line item.
Create the single line item that the draft will contain.
Complete the initial pricing sheet so the draft can be saved.
Commit a valid schedule for the draft.
Save the eRFX draft that will be reopened for the Manage Line Items test.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.
Show saved drafts only.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the single line item.
Confirm the requested Manage Line Items window is open.
Enter the quantity specified by the case.
Enter the negative price that should be rejected.
Attempt to save the invalid line-item values.
Assert that saving the negative price produces an application error.
